body.name: \(N^{\star}_{\mathrm{tree}}\) and \(N^{\star}_{\mathrm{cf}}\)
body.construction: \(N^{\star}_{\mathrm{tree}}(n,K,s)\) and \(N^{\star}_{\mathrm{cf}}(n,K,d,s)\) are obtained from \(\mathrm{def:minimax-count}\) by replacing \(\mathfrak M_{n,K,d,\tau}\) with \(\mathfrak M^{\mathrm{tree}}_{n,K}\) and \(\mathfrak M^{\mathrm{cf}}_{n,K,d}\), respectively.
